name: Scent of Evil
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 1, inquisitor 1, paladin 1, ranger 1

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range self
Target you
Duration 1 min./level

DESCRIPTION

You gain a supernatural ability to scent evil. This spell grants the scent special ability but only to detect evil creatures. Any ability or spell that hides a creature’s alignment like undetectable alignment thwarts this scent ability. Additionally, you gain a bonus to Perception and Survival checks using this scent ability depending on the strength of the creature’s evil aura power. Refer to the spell detect evil. You gain a +2 competence bonus on the skill check for each aura power level over ‘none’.

For example, you would gain a +4 competence bonus to your Perception and Survival checks against a 3rd-level evil cleric.
